blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Talisay City residents can avail of free veterinary services for their dogs and cats on October 9 as part of activities for the feast of Sta. Teresa de Avila. The Talisay City Government, through the Office of the City Veterinarian, will provide free anti-rabies vaccination, deworming, vitamin supplementation, pet consultation, and spaying and neutering services at the Talisay Sports Academy from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. The services are open to Talisay City residents. Separate requirements may apply depending on the service. Free veterinary services No preregistration is required for the free anti-rabies vaccination, deworming, vitamin supplementation, […]...
